phase: V2 PHASE 2: MARGINAL-PRESERVING JOINT PLAYER/STAT DEPENDENCE

inputs.rule: dependence is estimated only from true-OOS forecast/outcome pairs of the Phase 1B store (training_through_season < forecast_season); never from the final marginal's residuals; no 2026-27 data; no API calls; marginals are never changed

population.rows: participation_status == PLAYED with all 7 count labels; DNP / not on roster / unknown participation are not playing observations and are excluded (never zeros); P(play) is not used and never imputed
population.games: both teams must have eligible rows

latent_residual.sensitivity: RAND: randomized PIT, keyed BLAKE2b v per (game, player, stat), seed 20262
latent_residual.centering: z - E_model[z], then training mean per (role, stat)
latent_residual.scaling: training ratio sqrt(E[(z - Ez - delta)^2] / E[Var_model z]) per (role, stat)
latent_residual.attenuation: pooled moments divided by sum kappa_i kappa_j (first-order Hermite; kappa = E[z Z] from the marginal PMF)

structure.J1: within-player 7x7 latent correlation; hierarchy global -> role (L5 minutes rank band) -> role x position (G/F/C; U uses the role matrix); every level's deviation soft-thresholded at 1.96 game-clustered bootstrap SEs (200 draws); conditioning: a child keeps min eig >= 0.5 x its parent's (deviation scaled back, recorded)
structure.J2: J1 + same-team S and opposite-team X stat x stat latent correlations (distinct players), soft-thresholded the same way; A = (M + X)/2, B = (M - X)/2, Q = M - S with M the dominating additive Gram (NBA); Q admitted only by the pivotal-bootstrap competition gate (level 0.975); per-player shrink c_ab (A + B) then c_q (Q) keeps every residual block PSD

psd.rule: every game matrix is PSD by construction; validity floor min eig >= -1e-10; residual blocks >= 1e-09; Cholesky jitter only for rounding (recorded), rows renormalized to unit norm

simulation.common_random_numbers: one standard-normal bank per game shared by every candidate
simulation.mc_error: ES on draw halves, VS on two disjoint 2,000-draw replicates (reported VS = their mean); if, in the selection stage, any ES / VS_BAL interval bound used by the rule (J1-J0, J2-J0, J2-J1) lies within 3 MC SE of zero, the selection evaluation is rerun with 50000 draws and that rerun decides

retrospective_confirmation.runs: exactly once; selection unchanged by it

metrics.scale: each stat divided by its SD over the fit population's eligible rows (training only)
metrics.ES: energy score of the scaled full game vector (all eligible players x 7), mean over games [major]
metrics.VS_BAL: variogram score p = 0.5 on the scaled game vector, mean of the per-pair means of the three pair types (within player / same team / opposite team), mean over games [major]
metrics.COMBO_LOG: log score of PRA, PR, PA, RA, STOCKS from the same draws (MC PMF floored at 0.5/draws), mean over player x combo [major]
metrics.EVENT_BRIER: Brier score of the predefined joint threshold events, mean over events [major]
secondary: combo CRPS + Brier at J0-convolution quantile lines 0.25/0.5/0.75
count-space pair correlation calibration (diagnostic; centered by evaluation-season means)
metrics.uncertainty: game-level bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20264; 95% percentile intervals of paired differences

marginal_preservation.probes: per (player, stat): z of simulated mean, variance, P(X > q) at the analytic 0.25/0.5/0.75 quantiles, P(X = mode); KS distance; single-stat MC log score vs J0

PASS_if.per candidate x stat x probe: share |z| > 3.29 <= 0.005 and max |z| <= 6.5 (probes with >= 20 expected MC events)
PASS_if.KS: share of dims with KS > DKW(0.001) <= 0.005
PASS_if.construction: unit latent diagonal (|diag - 1| <= 1e-12) and 0 invalid matrices

passes_vs_J0: ES or VS_BAL improves with the 95% CI upper bound < 0
>= 3 of the 4 major metrics improve (point) and none is significantly worse
no combo materially degraded (log +0.002 nats or CRPS +0.5% with the CI excluding 0)
stability: added component's raw cells (F2024 fit vs a diagnostic F2025-only fit) correlate >= 0.7 and agree in sign on >= 90% of the cells nonzero in both
J2_adds_value_vs_J1: ES or VS_BAL improves vs J1 with CI upper < 0
>= 2 of ES, VS_BAL, EVENT_BRIER improve vs J1 (point)
no major metric significantly worse than J1
acceptance_rule.selection: J2 if it passes vs J0 and adds value vs J1; else J1 if it passes vs J0; else J0 (reported honestly)
